summary: Adecoagro S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K containing its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 earnings release and unaudited interim financial statements. Adjusted EBITDA reached $471.8 million for 9M26, an all-time high for a nine-month period and up 24.8% year-over-year, with the Fertilizers segment contributing $283.1 million. The release notes $9.2 million of one-off costs tied to Tether's prior tender offer, and pro forma net leverage of 3.2x including the December 2025 Profertil acquisition. No transaction, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the filing is an ordinary periodic results report with no actionable deal terms.
